worked_example.problem: Ashu eats well, but he sits in front of the television every evening and goes to bed very late. Which two health factors does he need to improve?
steps: He does not move his body much: he needs more exercise.
He goes to bed very late: he needs more rest and sleep.

cards.idea: Health is being well in body, mind and in our life with other people, not only being free from disease.
example: A pupil who is not sick but is always sad and alone is not fully healthy.

right.text: being well in body, mind and life with others, not only free from disease

wrong.explain: Health is more than that: it includes the mind and life with others.
Strength is only one part of health.
Too much food can cause obesity.
Money does not make a person healthy.

cards.idea: A good diet and regular exercise keep the body strong.
example: Walking to school and playing games are good exercise.

cards.idea: Rest, sleep and recreation (games, music, hobbies) refresh the body and the mind.
example: After a day of lessons, a game of football with friends is recreation.

pick.why: Exercise: Ngozi plays football after school.

wrong.text: It means you never need to eat.
